title: Beacon Inspector: Compact Failed-Request Triage Panel
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and prototype a compact right-rail panel (Beacon Inspector) for fast triage of failed requests inside the Redwood Console. The panel is intended for engineers and SREs who need immediate context on an errored or timed-out request without leaving the dashboard. Key responsibilities: surface error taxonomy (classification), show top-level payload highlights, provide masked KV preview, suggest retry strategies (auto-replay, canary routes), and present cost/latency delta for suggested actions. The focus is low-velocity discoverability: fast hypothesis formation, quick replay, and clear next-step affordances (open full request viewer, file ticket, copy request snapshot).
acceptance_criteria: Panel appears as a collapsible right-rail when a request is selected from any failed-requests list
Displays error class (e.g., ModelError, Timeout, Quota, Network) with one-line explanation and confidence score
Shows three most relevant payload fields with masking rules applied and a link to expand full masked payload
Provides suggested actions: Retry once (with modal to choose route), Open full request viewer, Create incident ticket (pre-populated), Copy snapshot
Includes a small cost/latency estimate card comparing last successful vs failed attempt
Design passes accessibility review (keyboard focus, color contrast, screen reader labels)
technical_notes: Panel must fetch only sanitized payload snippets from API: backend to apply masking policy and return field-level redaction metadata
Retry action will invoke the existing sandboxed replay API; design needs a confirmation modal with selectable route (hosted/dedicated/region fallback)
Cost estimate uses last token counts and model variant mapping - wire to runtime cost telemetry endpoint
If request contains secrets, show safe-placeholder and a disclosure explaining redaction policy
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha: Initial draft wireframes shared in figma. Goal is to reduce the time-to-first-hypothesis from 45s -> 15s when a user lands on a failed request.
2026-03-04 - Marina (PM): Prioritize showing error taxonomy and cost delta; users repeatedly ask "what changed" between last-success and failed attempt. Add small sparkline for latency history.
2026-03-05 - Ethan (Eng): Backend needs to expose 'redaction_hint' per field. Also flagged that fetching full masked payload will be paginated for large bodies.
2026-03-06 - Dr. Carlos (Security): Require explicit opt-in for showing any unmasked fields; default must be masked. Recommend retention rules appear in the full viewer only.
2026-03-07 - Design review: Decided compact panel shows top-3 fields inline; rest behind a "Show masked payload" accordion. Interaction pattern matches Console's existing right-rail affordances.

2026-03-08 - Prototype user test (3 engineers): Quick-replay button reduced time to reproduce in 2/3 sessions, but users wanted clearer routing options and a small confirmation about cost impact. Updated flows to include route selector and cost badge in modal.
2026-03-09 - Accessibility pass: Keyboard navigation verified for primary actions. Need to increase focus ring contrast on compact chips. Liam to iterate.
2026-03-10 - Ready for handoff: Handoff package uploaded to figma and PRD updated. Eng backlog ticket created for implementation. Next: tie into observability telemetry and rollout experiment.
review_feedback: PM: Add 'Why this happened' microcopy for each error class with links to diagnostic runbooks
Infra Eng: Make retry idempotent option explicit; prefer 'Replay (safe)' and 'Replay (full)'.
Security: Audit log event must be created for any payload view or replay action
Design: Consider micro-animations for collapse/expand to signal context shift without jarring layout shift
